rules.statement: A land owner does not have a statutory right to demand the exercise of the power by the Minister to revoke a vesting order under Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act No. 9 of 1950, as amended, where the possession of the land remains with the original landowner and the public purpose for which the land was acquired remains.
rules.supporting_quote: It would therefore be totally inconsistent with the statutory scheme to contend that any of these provisions, section 50(1), 39(1) or 39A afford a statutory right to a person interested in the land to demand the exercise of such power by the Minister.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act No. 9 of 1950, as amended
